source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 人民日报评银行该不该午休
topics.official_english: People's Daily comments on whether banks should take a lunch break
topics.why_hot: Touches on a common public complaint: banks closing at midday make it hard for working people to do business, and an official newspaper's comment has ignited debate over service efficiency.
topics.share_angle: Compare banking hours in China with other countries, explain why midday closures affect customers, and discuss what fair service hours could look like.

topics.chinese_topic: 尼泊尔泥石流已致903遇难4247失联
topics.why_hot: The scale of casualties is huge and still evolving, making it a major international disaster story closely followed by Chinese netizens.
topics.share_angle: Explain the disaster's scale, how mudslides happen in mountainous areas, and why terrain and weather make rescue difficult.

topics.chinese_topic: 网警公布10起涉吉隆泥石流谣言案
topics.official_english: Cyberpolice release 10 rumor cases linked to Gyirong mudslides
topics.why_hot: After a deadly disaster, false information can spread quickly and cause panic; the official disclosure shows how authorities are responding to misinformation.
topics.share_angle: Use the cases to help viewers identify disaster-related rumors and understand why sharing unverified information can be harmful.

topics.chinese_topic: 郑某造谣外卖员向饮料加百草枯被罚
topics.official_english: Person penalized for falsely claiming delivery worker added paraquat to drinks
topics.why_hot: Food safety rumors are highly inflammatory; this case shows the legal consequences of fabricating a story about a delivery worker contaminating drinks.
topics.share_angle: Explain what paraquat is, why the rumor alarmed people, and how Chinese law punishes those who spread false information online.

topics.chinese_topic: 保洁刚拖地孕妇滑倒 商场该不该负责
topics.official_english: Pregnant woman slips on just-mopped floor: is the mall liable?
topics.why_hot: It raises a familiar safety question about public venues and sparks discussion about duty of care, warning signs, and liability in everyday spaces.
topics.share_angle: Break down how property liability cases work in China and what both venues and visitors can do to prevent similar accidents.

topics.chinese_topic: 影院“隐形配置” 观影者直呼太遭罪
topics.official_english: Cinema's hidden setup leaves moviegoers complaining
topics.why_hot: Many moviegoers have experienced poor seating, bad sightlines, or other hidden cinema conditions, so the topic resonates with a wide audience.
topics.share_angle: Examine common cinema comfort issues in China and advise viewers on what to check before buying a ticket.

topics.why_hot: Unitree is a high-profile Chinese robotics company, so a sharp stock decline draws attention from people interested in tech investing and the robotics sector.
topics.share_angle: Provide background on Unitree, what a halved share price means for its valuation, and why robotics stocks can be volatile.

topics.chinese_topic: 公里要30元 景区摆渡车非坐不可吗
topics.official_english: Scenic shuttle bus fares spark debate: is 30 yuan per kilometer reasonable?
topics.why_hot: High shuttle bus prices at tourist sites are a common complaint, connecting tourism, consumer rights, and local regulation.
topics.share_angle: Compare scenic shuttle pricing with public transport, explain why tourists often feel forced to pay, and discuss how attractions could improve pricing transparency.
